issues.description: Aufgabe 03 in the problem statement requests three columns (Name, Straße and URL) for all Zoos in the Gemeinde with gemeindeschluessel '09162000' (problem_statement.md lines 116-118), but the reference solution (solution_repository/aufgabe03.sql) returns only the name column (SELECT name ...). This mismatch between the specification and the solution will confuse students about the expected result schema and will cause automated checks that verify selected columns to fail or behave inconsistently.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the solution match the problem specification by selecting the three requested columns. For example, update solution_repository/aufgabe03.sql to: SELECT name, strasse, url FROM Zoo WHERE gemeindeschluessel = '09162000'; Alternatively, if the intended requirement is to return only the name, update the problem statement to request only the name so all artifacts agree.
